newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares end weak on interest rates gloom.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares end weak on interest rates gloom.

text.p: Chilean blue chips closed softer as hopes fade of a cut in interest rates before year-end with the market expected to resume its downward drift at Tuesday's opening, said traders.
"The bolsa will not recover until the Central Bank's tightening is over," said Henry Rudnick, head of research at brokerage CB Capitales.
The gloom was caused by remarks last week from Central Bank President Carlos Massad that the bank's credit squeeze will continue until next year.
